shortDescription: Copy a file from Ansible Controller to a network device

options.name: dest
default: Filename from src and at default directory of user shell on network_os.
options.description: Specifies the destination file. The path to destination file can either be the full path or relative path as supported by network_os.

options.name: mode
options.description: Set the file transfer mode. If mode is set to I(text) then I(src) file will go through Jinja2 template engine to replace any vars if present in the src file. If mode is set to I(binary) then file will be copied as it is to destination device.

options.name: src
options.description: Specifies the source file. The path to the source file can either be the full path on the Ansible control host or a relative path from the playbook or role root directory.
